name: Bugs
question: Does software still break?
metric: New vulnerabilities published in the National Vulnerability Database, last 12 months
solvedIf: Fewer serious defects are found each year
trendLabel: New published vulnerabilities, rolling 12 months, one point per month.
caution: This counts reported vulnerabilities, not all bugs. More software and better detection, including by AI, also raise the count.
rule: More reported when more vulnerabilities are published than in the 12 months before.
scoreReason: Per git push: Up 23% since ChatGPT launched.
